SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
As we received case from an end customer, we
found the error
“SECC_KF11_GenData_MB_Problem”
Kindly check following points which we have mentioned-
Regarding error"SECC_DC2_MB_Problem_KF11".
Check if SECC2300 of dispenser is available & connected
Restart the SECC,
usually this solves this problem.
Basically error "SECC_DC2_MB_Problem" indicates the Modbus connection problem. Checked the cables and connections. We can try rebooting only the SECC once. If still issue persists then we try to be replacing the SECC.

Hi good afternoon, today i was on site to analyze the issue with the support of Joao and Francisco.
We found a Lan cable from Ecog to PLC malfunctioning and also inserted on the incorrect port.
After the analasis and the replacement of the Lan cable we tried some charging sessions with AC and CCS plug.
We will monitor this charger to understand if now the issue was solved.
For the moment i'm proceeding to close the ticket
Have a nice day
Giuseppe
